objective: Separate owner-channel information from arbitrary endpoint-order conventions in the native zero/bulk carrier.
source: RS079 selected vertices; exact roleless C sign counts and SIGNED_PARITY zero/bulk owner-separated count vectors.

definitions.LEX_OWNER0: Original full selected vertex lexicographic order w|cap|dh0|dh1.
definitions.LEX_OWNER1: Compare keys obtained by swapping dh0/dh1 fields, but compute signed deltas in original owner channels.
definitions.OWNER_ANON_TIE_ORBIT: Compare w|cap plus lexicographically sorted two owner histogram strings; if equal use the lexicographic minimum of the two endpoint-directed pair records.
definitions.PREFIX_TIE_ORBIT: Compare w|cap only; if equal take endpoint-reversal orbit minimum.
definitions.FULL_EDGE_REVERSAL_ORBIT: Always take endpoint-reversal orbit minimum of the signed count record.

procedure: Test endpoint permutation invariance and reversal involution, including an owner-anonymous tie and a pair whose owner0/owner1 orders differ.
Prepare every pooled catalog, row, basis and complete kernel; commit before replay.
Replay fixed scalar characters and individual/pooled factorization; reproduce the original rank353 source kernel.
guards: Tie orbits are explicitly part of the maps, not arbitrary owner-priority tiebreakers.
Alternative orientations are maps from selected vertices, not presumed quotients of the compressed original gauge.
No H/V/D geometric-orientation reopening, no fitted coefficients, no synthetic outcomes.
